elements_selected.content: Extend drift detection to cover explicit source metadata groundings per REQ-043b. For each SPL block with explicit groundings (in ExplicitGrounding): 1) Resolve each source_ref to a current Merkle leaf hash (re-resolve against current vault state), 2) Compare to cached target_leaf_hash in theory.json spl_blocks explicit_groundings, 3) If target hash changed AND the SPL construct (fact or rule) is unchanged → explicit drift Warning. The DriftDiagnostic has DriftType::ExplicitDrift { construct, source_ref }. If target not found (hash no longer in vault) — this is a static validation error (source_validation), NOT drift. Only report explicit drift when the target EXISTS but has a different hash. Update detect_section_drift to also handle explicit groundings, or create detect_explicit_drift as a separate function. Merge explicit drift results into the same Vec<DriftDiagnostic> returned by the drift detection phase. Wire into cmd_check alongside section drift.
